verdict.rationale: Lithic is a card-issuing and payments API platform, not an AI agent or host application. Plugging external MCP servers into it so it can call their tools is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence shows only that Lithic publishes its own official MCP server for AI editors to connect to (the server role), which belongs to a different story and does not make this MCP-client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
